Disabled in the Crucible.

Stowing your weapon while Built Bitter is active starts Critical Health Regeneration and restores HP based on the number of stacks lost by swapping weapons:
• 1|2|3|4 stacks: <pve approximately 35 /> <pvp [?] /> | <pve approximately 65 /> <pvp [?] /> | <pve 87.5 /> <pvp [?] /> | <pve approximately 105 /> <pvp [?] /> HP.
• 5|6|7 stacks: <pve 130 /> <pvp [?] /> | <pve approximately 170 /> <pvp [?] /> | <pve 195 /> <pvp [?] /> HP.
• 8|9|10 stacks: <pve full heal /> <pvp [?] />.

Healing can inconsistently be much higher than these values.

4 Piece | Bittersweet
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<< 

On Weapon Stow, while Built Bitter stacks are active.
Begins Critical Health Regeneration.
Restores Health based on the amount of Built Bitter stacks lost by swapping weapons.
Do note there are some weird inconsistencies that can result in MUCH higher healing values.

x1 = ~35 [?] | x2 = ~65 [?] | x3 = 87.5 [?] | x4 = ~105 [?] | x5 = 130 [?]
x6 = ~170 [?] | x7 = 195 [?] | x8 = Full Heal [?] | x9 = Full Heal [?] | x10 = Full Heal [?] 

But acktually you should test with Brawn beyond x8!
